summary: The pandas editable build failed while compiling ARM64 NEON SIMD C++ sources. Explicit instantiations using xsimd::neon64 did not match the operator template signature resolved with xsimd::neon.
root_cause: The explicit instantiations of accumulate_moments_simd::operator() with xsimd::neon64 do not match the function template signature involving xsimd::neon, causing Clang compilation errors in the moments SIMD implementation.

evidence.reason: Identifies the failed C++ compilation unit.

evidence.quote: ../../pandas/_libs/include/pandas/simd/moments_simd.hpp:255:50: error: explicit instantiation of 'operator()' does not refer to a function template, variable template, member function, member class, or static data member
evidence.reason: States the direct compiler error at the extern template instantiation.

evidence.quote: candidate template ignored: could not match 'Moments (xsimd::neon64, std::span<const double>, int, std::optional<std::span<const uint8_t>>, int) noexcept' (aka 'Moments (xsimd::neon64, span<const double>, int, optional<span<const unsigned char>>, int) noexcept') against 'Moments (xsimd::neon, std::span<const double>, int, std::optional<std::span<const uint8_t>>, int)' (aka 'Moments (xsimd::neon, span<const double>, int, optional<span<const unsigned char>>, int)')
evidence.reason: Explicitly shows the xsimd::neon64 versus xsimd::neon signature mismatch.

evidence.quote: ../../pandas/_libs/simd/moments_inst_neon.cpp:14:43: error: explicit instantiation of 'operator()' does not refer to a function template, variable template, member function, member class, or static data member
evidence.reason: Confirms the same invalid explicit instantiation in the NEON implementation source.
Confirms that the compiler errors stopped the build.

suggested_fix: Make the NEON explicit instantiations in pandas/_libs/include/pandas/simd/moments_simd.hpp and pandas/_libs/simd/moments_inst_neon.cpp use the architecture type that matches the accumulate_moments_simd::operator() template signature, resolving the xsimd::neon64 versus xsimd::neon mismatch.
